feat: Complete Phase 1 & 2 - Self-hosted landscape visualization tool

Implement a comprehensive system landscape visualization tool that combines
YAML-based diagram definitions with interactive drag-and-drop positioning.
Built for privacy-focused organizations requiring self-hosted solutions.

## Phase 1: Foundation Setup ✅

### Backend (Python + FastAPI)
- FastAPI application with async support
- Pydantic models for YAML schema validation
- YAML parser and serialization (PyYAML)
- File service with async I/O (aiofiles)
- REST API endpoints for landscape CRUD operations
- Comprehensive data validation and error handling
- Sample landscape with 8 systems and 7 connections

### Frontend (TypeScript + React + Vite)
- React 18 with TypeScript for type safety
- Zustand state management
- Axios API client with full endpoint coverage
- TypeScript types mirroring backend Pydantic models
- Vite build system with HMR

## Phase 2: Core Visualization ✅

### Interactive Diagram Canvas
- React Flow integration for interactive diagrams
- Custom system nodes with color-coding by type
- Custom connection edges with multiple line styles
- Drag-and-drop positioning with auto-save
- Zoom, pan, and minimap controls
- Real-time position updates to backend

### Data Flow
- YAML → Pydantic → API → React → React Flow
- Drag event → Position update → API → YAML file
- Bidirectional sync between visual and code

### Visual Features
- Color-coded system types (customer-facing, backend, database, etc.)
- Connection labels with type indicators
- Line styles: solid, dashed, dotted
- Beautiful node styling with metadata display
- Responsive layout with info overlay

## Documentation 📚

### Comprehensive Documentation System
- CLAUDE.md: Complete technical reference for AI assistants
- FILE_INDEX.md: Full file map and architecture guide
- DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md: Navigation guide for all docs
- GETTING_STARTED.md: Quick start guide
- PHASE2_COMPLETE.md: Feature documentation
- docs/yaml-schema.md: Complete YAML reference
- docs/deployment.md: Production deployment guide

### Key Features Documented
- YAML schema with examples
- API endpoints with request/response formats
- Component architecture and data flow
- Development setup instructions
- Troubleshooting guides

## Technology Stack

**Backend:**
- Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic, PyYAML, Uvicorn
- aiofiles, Playwright (future), websockets (future)

**Frontend:**
- TypeScript, React 18, Vite
- React Flow 11, Zustand, Axios, js-yaml
- Monaco Editor (Phase 3)

**Development:**
- uv for Python package management
- npm for JavaScript dependencies
- Git for version control

## File Structure

- backend/: Python FastAPI application
  - app/: Main application code
    - models/: Pydantic data models
    - services/: Business logic (YAML, file operations)
    - api/: REST API routes
  - data/: YAML landscape files
- frontend/: React TypeScript application
  - src/components/: React components (DiagramCanvas, nodes, edges)
  - src/stores/: Zustand state management
  - src/services/: API client and utilities
  - src/types/: TypeScript type definitions
  - src/utils/: Data transformation utilities
- docs/: User and technical documentation
- docker/: Docker deployment (Phase 7)

## Privacy & Security

- Self-hosted: No external API calls
- Complete data control and privacy
- File-based storage (no database required)
- Path sanitization to prevent directory traversal
- CORS properly configured

## Usage

1. Backend: `PYTHONPATH=... python -m app.main` (port 8000)
2. Frontend: `npm run dev` (port 5173)
3. Create YAML files in backend/data/
4. Visualize and drag-and-drop to position systems
5. Changes auto-save to YAML

- Phase 3: Monaco Editor for live YAML editing
- Phase 4: Enhanced sync with WebSocket support
- Phase 5: Export to PDF, PNG, SVG
- Phase 6: UX enhancements (auto-layout, properties panel)
- Phase 7: Docker deployment and packaging
